authority.title: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.notes: Section 20.1 specifies the parent, reactor, optional extension dictionary, object-specific handle sequence, and byte-alignment padding; it does not require padding bits to be zero. Section 20.4.44 specifies counted names and item handles.
